content.short: Blast Wheels is a high-speed multiplayer racing game on Sui featuring NFT car ownership and PvP combat for players.
content.description: Blast Wheels is a fast-paced, play-to-earn arcade racing game built on the Sui blockchain. It offers a thrilling multiplayer experience where players from around the world can compete in real-time races. Central to the game is the concept of digital ownership, with each car represented as a unique NFT that players can own, upgrade, and trade. These cars come with varying statistics such as speed, durability, and maneuverability, allowing for a personalized racing style and strategic depth in every competition. The game also incorporates tactical PvP combat, enabling players to use weapons to eliminate opponents while racing towards the finish line. Powered by the $WHEELS token.
content.meta: Blast Wheels is a multiplayer racing game on Sui featuring NFT cars and $WHEELS rewards. Discover Blast Wheels and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
